name: Revvity, Inc.
moat_justification: Niche installed bases in newborn/reproductive screening, immunodiagnostics and high-content screening give recurring reagents and switching friction, but the measured franchise is weak: roic_proxy in fundamentals.json fell from 12.8% at the COVID-peak year to 2.72% / 3.22% / 3.34% in the last three fiscal years — well below cost of capital — against far larger rivals (Thermo Fisher, Danaher, Abbott) and a shrinking China immunodiagnostics position now being divested.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 2.7%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.2x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 4.1x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
one_liner: Decent diagnostics/life-sciences franchise, moat 4/10 with ~3% ROIC — does not clear 15% at $152.46 (weighted IRR 6.2%, IV@15% $44.18, even super-bull IRR only 9.5%); clears 15% only below $44.18.
moat_for: Installed base in newborn screening and reproductive health — assays embedded in regional/national screening programs, real switching friction
High-content screening instruments (Opera Phenix line) are a de facto standard in phenotypic drug discovery, pulling through reagents and assay kits
Recurring reagent/consumable revenue attached to the instrument base in both Diagnostics and Life Sciences
Signals informatics software embedded in pharma discovery workflows
moat_against: ROIC proxy collapsed to ~3% for three straight years (fundamentals.json) — the BioLegend-era capital base is not earning its cost of capital
Much larger, better-capitalized rivals (Thermo Fisher, Danaher, Abbott) contest every category
China immunodiagnostics weakness forced a divestiture of that business (announced with Q2 2026 results)
Signals software revenue fell ~20% organically in Q2 2026 — the software pillar is not currently compounding
End-market exposure to pharma/biotech and academic budgets is cyclical, as the post-COVID revenue decline showed
